details:
It has been a common recurring topic regarding the Orange status and how there is often a lot of ambiguity when one is on Orange, Red, or other colors regardless of their custom status. At the end of the day, it's up to the user on how much they want to share what they're up to for the sake of privacy. But some people may want to share a bit more of what we're up to so that others can get reassurance that they're doing alright and not feel worried.

Essentially the goal is to add an extra bit of clarity to one's status and be able to do so easily and quickly without having to manually type out a custom status every time.

Facebook has a feature in which one can add how they're feeling to their post, as well as activities they may be participating in. This is done through quick drop-down menus.

For example, the Facebook headline would say something like:

"Bob" is feeling "excited". or "Bob" is "dancing at a party".

No matter how you may feel about Facebook as a social media platform, this feature allows for greater customizability over what people want to share about themselves.

This could be a potential solution for those who are discouraged to request invite because they're afraid of bad timing but want reassurance on their friends. I would also add the ability to add your own custom emotions or activities so that they can be quickly accessed when needed.

Users would still have the option to not use this feature and keep completely private if they wish when they're on a status like Orange. This is simply an extra way for people to express themselves in their profiles and statuses.
title: Ability to Describe Emotions and/or Activities in Custom Statuses via Drop Down Menus
